question: What is a secret about your job that would get you fired instantly?
story: My boss thinks I saved the company forty thousand dollars. I actually just deleted an email. Let me explain. Two years ago we were paying for software nobody used. My job was to research whether we should cancel it. Instead I forgot. For six months. When my boss finally asked, I panicked and said I already handled it. So I quietly canceled the thing and told him I negotiated us out of the contract. He was thrilled. He put me in a meeting to explain my genius negotiation tactics. I made up a whole story about calling their sales team. I invented a guy named Dave. My boss loved Dave. Now every quarter he asks me to call Dave again. Dave does not exist. I have built an entire career on a man I invented. Please clap.
